A '''spaceport''' was located on the planet [[Tammuz-an/Legends|Tammuz-an]].

==History==
The spaceport serviced civilian and military [[Starship/Legends|spacecraft]]. It was situated inside the [[Tammuz-an capital city|capital city]] of [[Tammuz-an/Legends|Tammuz-an]] and was an important link to the outside [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]. [[Mon Julpa]] and his companions landed here during his bid to become [[King/Legends|King]] of Tammuz-an. [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Coby]] took a passenger flight to [[Chuzalla]] from this spaceport when he was preparing to enlist in the [[Imperial Academy/Legends|Imperial Academy]].
